# Invoke-ZbxApi

## SYNOPSIS

Calls any Zabbix API method with the parameters given.

## SYNTAX

```
Invoke-ZbxApi [-Method] <string> [[-Body] <object>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

-Body is the method's parameters exactly as the API takes them: a hashtable, a [pscustomobject], or a JSON string; the result comes back the same way ConvertFrom-Json would shape it. A *.get method (and apiinfo.version) is read-only and skips the -WhatIf/-Confirm gate; every other method can mutate, so it is gated like any other change (ConfirmImpact Medium).

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Call a read method with a hashtable body

```powershell
Invoke-ZbxApi -Method 'host.get' -Body @{ output = @('hostid', 'host', 'status'); filter = @{ host = 'web-01' } }
```

-Body is the method's params exactly as the API documents them; the result comes back as ConvertFrom-Json would shape it (wire field names, not the typed records' property names). *.get methods skip -WhatIf/-Confirm.

### Example 2: Pass the body as JSON text

```powershell
Invoke-ZbxApi -Method 'hostgroup.get' -Body '{"output":["groupid","name"],"filter":{"name":["Linux servers","Web servers"]}}'
```

A JSON string works as well as a hashtable, e.g. a request copied from the API documentation.

### Example 3: Call a method that changes something

```powershell
$hostId = (Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01').HostId
Invoke-ZbxApi -Method 'host.update' -Body @{ hostid = $hostId; description = 'Front end, rack 4' } -WhatIf
Invoke-ZbxApi -Method 'host.update' -Body @{ hostid = $hostId; description = 'Front end, rack 4' }
```

Every method that is not a *.get can change the server, so it is gated like any other change (ConfirmImpact Medium): -WhatIf shows what would be called. The result is the method's own, here host.update's hostids.

### Example 4: Call a method that takes no parameters

```powershell
Invoke-ZbxApi apiinfo.version
```

-Body defaults to {}; apiinfo.version needs no authentication and answers the server's version string.
